Hi Michael,

Thanks for the DPA draft earlier this week. We are close to final sign-off but have one outstanding ask from our legal and security teams around a temporary regional reprocessing carve-out. Specifically: 

- For planned maintenance or disaster recovery, we need a clear runbook and evidence workflow for any transient processing that might occur outside our designated EU data region for up to 96 hours.
- Required evidence: per-request telemetry showing timestamps, origin region, destination region, KMS envelope metadata (key ID only), and a signed attest from your ops team that no customer data persisted outside pinned hosts beyond the window.
- We also need confirmation of which subprocessors would be involved in such a window and whether any HSM-backed key operations would occur in a different jurisdiction.

Can Redwood provide a short runbook we can include as an annex to the DPA and an example of the telemetry artifact you would produce? If possible, please include a named contact and a timeline for when you can supply the artifacts — procurement wants this before they finalize the order.

Appreciate your help — Priya (DPO, MediGuide)

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear note. Looping in Ben (account lead) and Monica (compliance/legal) so we can provide the runbook and the example telemetry you asked for.

Short answer: yes — we can provide a formal runbook and an example telemetry artifact that meets the items you listed. A few clarifying items so we produce exactly what you need:

1) Window length: you asked for up to 96 hours. Our standard transient reprocessing window for pinned-region customers is 72 hours; we can document a conditional 96-hour escalation flow but it requires an approval step and an extended attest (ops + SOC contact). Which do you prefer for the annex?

2) Evidence fields: we will include timestamps (UTC), source region, destination region, VM/host id (hashed), KMS envelope key-id (not plaintext key material), and an ops attest with runbook execution id. Is a signed ops attest (PGP-signed PDF) acceptable?

3) Subprocessors: transient reprocessing may involve our cloud-provider edge-cache and our metrics ingestion service (both listed in the DPA subprocessor roster). We will include a per-event subprocessor roster slice. Do you need IP ranges for the temporary hosts?

Action plan: Monica and I will prepare a 1) runbook annex, 2) a sample telemetry JSON redacted of PII, and 3) an ops attest template. Ben will confirm procurement timing. Target: initial package to you by Monday 24 Mar EOD.

— Michael

Priya — attached is the runbook annex and a redacted sample telemetry artifact. Summary of the commitments in the annex: 

- Standard window: 72 hours. Emergency extension to 96 hours possible with documented approval from Redwood Security + customer SSO owner; extension includes an extended ops attest (signed) and additional audit log disclosure.
- Subprocessors: transient hosts may involve the cloud edge-cache (EdgeServe Inc.) and ingestion broker (MetricsHub). Both are named in section 5 of the DPA; we add a temporary-slice clause that requires Redwood to notify MediGuide within 12 hours of invoking a transient window.
- KMS/HSM: envelope operations (key-id only) may occur in a different region if customer-managed key rotation is not in place; customer-managed keys (BYOK with HSM) can prevent key material crossing borders.
- Evidence artifact: sample file attached (redacted). Fields included: event_id, start_ts_utc, end_ts_utc, source_region, dest_region, host_hash, key_id, subprocessors_involved, operator_id (opaque), runbook_exec_id.

Please see the two attachments: mediguide_dpa_section-pin-exception_v1.pdf (text to swap into your DPA) and sample_telemetry_redacted.json (example).

If this looks good we can: 1) insert the annex into the DPA, 2) provide a monthly extract of transient-window events for your records, and 3) provide an ops contact for attestation signing when windows are invoked.

Kimberly — can you confirm the PGP signing process and whether Ops can provide a timestamped signed PDF within 24 hours of window close?
